, Reason for Mistake: The Planner correctly gathered the data that "Circus of Love" was released in 1954 and "The Kiss of Evil" (an alternate title for *The Kiss of the Vampire*) was released in 1963. However, in Step 6, the Planner made a logical error in the final comparison. It stated: "Circus of Love was released more recently. Circus of Love released in 1954, whereas The Kiss of Evil... was released in 1963." This is a contradiction; 1963 is more recent than 1954. The Planner failed to correctly conclude that *The Kiss of Evil* is the more recent film based on the evidence it had just verified.
